description: This file defines a Flutter widget called HourlyForecastRow that displays a horizontally scrollable row of hourly weather forecast items. Each item includes an icon, time label, and temperature, and is wrapped in a focusable card.

classes.name: HourlyForecastRow
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget that shows a horizontal list of hourly forecast items with focus support.

methods.name: _iconFromName
methods.description: Maps weather icon names to Flutter icon data; defaults to cloud icon if name is unrecognized.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget layout: a sized box containing a horizontal list of forecast items.
